app.name: Glifora
app.tagline: Learn languages by talking with the villagers.
lang.label: Interface language
common.save_failed: Could not save. Please try again.
install.ios.title: Install Glifora on your iPhone
install.ios.steps: Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. The game then opens like an app.
install.ios.export: Safari deletes data from sites that are not installed after 7 days without use. Export your progress to keep a copy.
nav.label: Main navigation
home.title: The village
home.hint: Tap a place to go in.
home.hint_swipe: Swipe sideways and tap a place to go in.
hud.label: Your progress
hud.xp: {into} of {total} XP to the next level
street.label: Village street
welcome.title: Welcome to Glifora
welcome.text: Here you learn languages by talking with the villagers. Pick the app language and, if you like, a nickname.
profile.spoken: As spoken in conversations, the villagers will call you: {name}.
profile.spoken_none: The villagers will not use a name for you (it needs up to 10 letters, letters only, in the first word or the whole nickname).
nickname.hint: Up to {max} characters. It stays on this device only.
nickname.error.long: The nickname can have at most {max} characters.
nickname.error.chars: The nickname cannot contain < or >, control characters, or invisible characters, and it needs at least one visible character.
place.bakery.about: The smell of warm bread reaches the square. Here you order food and learn to say how many you want.
npc.tilda.name: Tilda
profile.title: Your profile
profile.base.hint: This is the language of translations and tips. Choices on this screen are saved right away.
settings.title: Settings
settings.text: These choices apply right away and are kept on this device.
settings.motion.system_hint: Reduces motion if the device is set that way.
settings.sounds.hint: There are no sounds yet. Your choice is already saved.
about.title: About Glifora
about.text: A free, open source game for learning languages by talking. Your progress stays on this device only.
about.license.title: Licenses
about.license.code: The code is free software under the GNU AGPL-3.0.
about.license.content: The missions and other content (content/ folder) are under CC BY-SA 4.0.
about.license.name: The name "Glifora" is not licensed.
notfound.title: Page not found
notfound.text: There is nothing at this address.
error.title: Something went wrong
error.text: Try again. If the problem continues, reload the page.
storage_error.title: Could not open the data on this device
storage_error.text: The browser blocked local storage. This happens in private windows or when storage is turned off. Allow storage for this site and try again.
data.title: Your data
data.intro: Everything stays on this device only. Export a file to keep your progress or take it to another device.
data.import.hint: Whatever is newer in the file wins; the rest stays as it is. Importing the same file again changes nothing.

data.import.done.one: Import finished: {n} new or updated item.
data.import.done.other: Import finished: {n} new or updated items.

data.import.nothing: Nothing new in the file: your data was already up to date.
data.import.skipped: Part of the file comes from a newer version of Glifora and was skipped. Update the app to use it.
data.error.heading: Could not import
data.error.too_large: The file is larger than {mb} MB, which is the limit.
data.error.not_json: The file is not valid JSON. Pick a file exported by Glifora.
data.error.wrong_format: This file does not look like it was exported by Glifora.
data.error.too_new: This file is from a newer version of Glifora (format {file}; this app understands up to format {app}). Update the app and try again.
data.error.doc_too_new: This file came from a newer version of Glifora. Close and reopen the app to update it, then try again.
data.error.invalid: The file has problems and nothing was imported. If you need help, copy the details below.
data.error.storage: Could not save to this device.
data.error.copy_failed: Could not copy. Select the text above and copy it.
data.wipe.heading: Erase everything
data.wipe.hint: Removes the profile, avatar, preferences and chosen language from this device.
data.wipe.button: Erase the data on this device
data.wipe.confirm_text: The profile, avatar, preferences and chosen language will be erased from here, with no way back. If you want to keep your progress, export it first.
settings.voice.title: Voice
settings.voice.text: Check what this device can say and understand.
voice.check.title: Voice check
voice.check.intro: See how this device speaks and listens. Say the test phrase and look at the alternatives the browser heard: this shows how well it understands you.
voice.status.speak_no: Speaking out loud: not available in this browser.
voice.status.voices_none: No voice for this language on this device. Texts will show without sound.
voice.status.listen_no: Listening: not available in this browser.
voice.check.no_voice: Could not play: this device has no voice for this language, or the browser blocked the sound.
voice.check.listen_hint: Tap the microphone, say the phrase above (or any other), and wait. Nothing is saved.
voice.check.alternatives: What the browser heard, best first
voice.consent.title: Before you use the microphone
voice.consent.text: When you speak, the audio goes to your browser's speech service (for example Google in Chrome or Apple in Safari), not to Glifora. Glifora never receives or stores your voice. Next, the browser will ask for permission to use the microphone.
voice.nomic.notice: This browser cannot listen to your voice, so you will answer by typing. Everything else works the same.
voice.fail.no_speech: I did not hear anything. Tap the microphone and try again, a little closer.
voice.fail.denied: The microphone is blocked. Allow it in the browser's site settings, or type your answer instead.
voice.fail.network: The browser's speech service could not be reached. Check your connection, or type your answer instead.
voice.fail.lang: This browser cannot recognize this language. Type your answer instead.
voice.fail.unsupported: This browser cannot listen, or this device has no microphone. Type your answer instead.
voice.test.title: Phrase test
voice.test.intro: Read {n} short English phrases out loud, one at a time. The app checks whether the browser understood each one well enough to pick the right answer, the same way the missions do.
voice.test.privacy: Glifora does not save or send anything: the result only exists on this screen and in the text you choose to copy. Your voice is heard by the browser's speech service, as in the microphone notice.
voice.test.error_missing: The phrases for this test are not available right now. Check your connection and reload.
voice.test.error_invalid: The phrases for this test could not be read.
voice.test.no_listen: This browser cannot listen to your voice, so the phrase test is not available here. Try Chrome on Android.
voice.test.res_broken: This phrase points to an answer that does not exist (content error).
voice.test.text_label: Result text (if copying fails, select it and copy by hand)
voice.test.copied: Copied. Paste it in the conversation.
voice.test.copy_failed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.
place.tavern.about: A warm, noisy room full of stories. Here you ask for a table, order a drink and chat with the regulars.
npc.bram.name: Bram
place.missions.none: There are no missions here yet for your language pair.
play.error.title: I couldn't open this mission
play.error.text: The mission content didn't open. Go back and try again.
play.mode.title: How do you want to play?
play.mode.1.hint: The phrases are on screen and you say them.
play.mode.2.hint: Only the idea, in your language, is shown. You say the phrase.
play.mode.3.hint: Nothing on screen. You remember and speak.
play.mode.boss: This is a boss mission: it always starts with no help. You can ask for help along the way without losing anything.
play.resume.title: You were in the middle of this mission
play.resume.text: You can pick up where you left off or start over.
play.listen.title: Listen to the scene
play.listen.hint: Hear how people talk before you answer.
play.help.raised: No problem! One more help on screen.
play.input.label: Or write your answer
play.closing.title: Now, in your own words
play.model.title: Try saying it like this
play.model.text: Say it out loud or type it. If you prefer, tap to move on.
play.done.error: I couldn't save the mission on this device.
report.title: Mission report
report.cando.no_hint: To achieve this goal, speak or type your answers without tapping the options, and say the closing phrase.
report.xp.title: XP earned
report.levelup.title: New title: {title}
report.recasts.title: More natural ways to say it
report.recasts.none: No expected slips this time. Very good!
report.recasts.said: You said “{original}” and the talk went on with “{corrected}”.
report.words.title: New words
report.closing.title: Your closing phrase
report.closing.tap: You tapped to move on, without saying a phrase.
report.next.title: What now?
report.next.again_hint: With less help you earn the next star.
